entry.title: fix(azure): add DeepSeek reasoning controls and tool support (#11392)
entry.content:
fix(azure): add DeepSeek reasoning controls and tool support (#11392)

* fix(azure): add DeepSeek reasoning controls and tool support

The DeepSeek V4 models on Azure (Foundry) return their chain of thought in
reasoning_content, but only when the request sets reasoning_effort; without it
reasoning is off and reasoning_content is null. The catalog declared neither the
effort control nor the reasoning field, so OpenCode showed no thinking for these
models.

Verified live 2026-10-25 against a Foundry resource:
- reasoning_effort=low|high|max turns reasoning on and populates reasoning_content
- the endpoint's own 400 lists none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max
- reasoning is off by default (reasoning_content null without the parameter)
- DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro return tool_calls, so tools are supported

Adds reasoning controls (toggle + effort low/high/max, matching providers/deepseek
and providers/opencode for this model), compatibility.reasoning_field, and corrects
tools to supported for V4-Flash and V4-Pro.

* fix(azure): model DeepSeek reasoning off as effort none

* fix(azure): inherit DeepSeek tool support from base model

---------

Co-authored-by: Aiden Cline <aidenpcline@gmail.com>
